messages:
eli_finance: Alert: our weekly usage-aggregation job (agg-run-20240630) created duplicate volume_discount credits for ~42 customers in CET timezone due to DST window. Rough impact: $5.6k overcredited. net-report-bot shows two emit batches with same window id.

net-report-bot: agg-run-20240630 started at 2024-06-30T00:00:05+02:00. Emitted 42 credit adjustments. agg-run-20240630-retry started at 2024-06-30T01:00:12+02:00. Emitted 42 credit adjustments (duplicate).

rachel_billing: yikes. Which invoices were affected? Are these credits already applied in NetSuite or pending?

eli_finance: Most credits hit immediately as credit memos in NetSuite. Affected customers sample: BeaconAI, HappyMetrics, NimbusOps. We'll need to reverse 42 credit memos and re-issue correct ones.

sam_engineering: I pulled logs. Root cause looks like the scheduler re-invoked the aggregator for the same day because our cron window logic uses local date string for run_id (YYYYMMDD) and DST hour shift created an overlap that made the health-check think the original run hung. We didn't persist a run_uuid before emitting adjustments, so re-run emitted again.

sam_engineering: Log snippet:\n```\n2024-06-30T00:00:05+02:00 INFO agg-run-20240630 run_id=20240630 emitted=42
2024-06-30T00:30:00+02:00 WARN health-check: last-heartbeat=2024-06-30T00:00:05 perceived-stalled=true
2024-06-30T01:00:12+02:00 INFO agg-run-20240630-retry run_id=20240630 emitted=42
```\n
tony_ops: Ops changed the health-check threshold on 2024-06-29 to be more aggressive (1m). DST shift + our worker GC spikes caused it to mark run as stalled and trigger retry. We should revert threshold and add more robust run-state persistence.

veda_tax: We also need to check tax handling for the duplicate credits. Creating reversals will change taxable base for June—need to notify tax team and update month-end filings if necessary.

rachel_billing: Action items: 1) pause aggregator scheduler for CET zone until fix deployed (Tony) 2) script to auto-detect duplicate credit memos and queue reversal approvals (Eli/Rachel) 3) patch: persist run_uuid before emitting and use monotonic idempotency for each adjustment (Sam) 4) notify customers in impacted list with apology & net effect (Rachel).

sam_engineering: I'll open PR with two changes: persist run_uuid earlier and change run_id to include timestamp+UUID (so not just YYYYMMDD). Also add a pre-emit dedupe check that queries NetSuite for existing credit memos using our adjustment_id. ETA: hotfix in ~3h.

eli_finance: I'll write the reversal script. We should target automated reversal draft creation but require manager approval before posting to NetSuite. I'll tag accounting leads.

tony_ops: Scheduler paused for CET worker groups. Monitoring enabled to ensure no more retries.

net-report-bot: duplicate-detect job queued: dup-detect-20240630. Scanning invoices for run_id=20240630...

net-report-bot: dup-detect-20240630 report: 42 duplicates found; 42 credit_memo_ids present in NetSuite. Suggested action: create reversal drafts for all 42.

rachel_billing: Copying internal customer-notify template now. Will coordinate with CS and legal for messaging. Also starting approval flow for reversals.

veda_tax: Please include tax team in reversal approvals; we need ledger entries for audit.

sam_engineering: Hotfix deployed to persist run_uuid and added idempotency tokens. Pre-emit dedupe check passes locally. Will monitor production after a canary run.

eli_finance: Reversal drafts created (see sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/finance/dup-credits-20240630). 10 reversals require manual review due to custom billing items. Requesting approvals from @rachel_billing and @veda_tax.

rachel_billing: Approved for automated reversal for 32 customers. I'll review the 10 manual ones now.

sam_engineering: Canary run completed — no duplicate emits detected. Closing remediation ticket after accounting confirms reversals posted.

eli_finance: Thanks team. We'll file an incident postmortem and update run docs to include DST guidance. :thumbsup:
